testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, forms, links, navigation items, theme toggles, and buttons MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-services-link', data-testid='contact-submit-btn', data-testid='theme-toggle-btn').
testing_and_accessibility.aria: Include aria-expanded on mobile menu, aria-hidden='true' on purely decorative 3D canvas and SVG icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Lenis smooth scrolling or Framer Motion scroll triggers are properly initialized.
Use sonner for toast notifications upon form submission.
Implement theme persistence using localStorage and React state/context.
Verify that ALL device mockup SVGs avoid embedded text and use abstract geometric UI blocks.
Ensure dark mode is default on initial site load.
